evidence: DESIGN-NOTES.md:247-258 approves activation only for an unoccupied summarizer, reuse of an existing occupant without requiring idleness, durable pending requests, and explicit completion distinct from dispatch. CURRENT-DESIGN.md:32-34 repeats that contract and :54 names summarizer crash/retry as open. Full-text checks for stalled/stuck/hung/unresponsive work, timeout/heartbeat/progress, failure reporting, reminder, retry, reassignment, and monitoring across all four artifacts found no policy for a present occupant whose dispatched work never completes. CURRENT-DESIGN.md:17 and DESIGN-NOTES.md:170-189 cover failed graph mutations and external reconciliation, not transcript-processing request liveness; SOFTWARE-FACTORY-VISION.md:77 covers a separate instance monitoring recipe. Narrowly, a request can remain visibly pending indefinitely while the summarizer is present, preventing the transcript result/coverage promised in DESIGN-NOTES.md:255-258 and weakening cross-session continuity (HERDR-GRAPH-VISION.md:137-139). This is an acknowledged design-stage gap, not a claim of actual data loss or a requirement for a plugin worker pool or periodic model wake.
